stemMd: For which real x is log(x−2) + log(5−x) defined?
explanationMd: Each logarithm requires a strictly positive argument. Intersect x>2 and x<5 to obtain the open interval; multiplication of the arguments cannot replace these separate domain conditions.

distractorRationale.d: This makes the first logarithm's argument negative.
distractorRationale.e: This makes the second argument negative.
distractorRationale.b: Logarithms of zero are undefined at the endpoints.
